u8[16], bone -> destroyed-zone bit index for obj+0x1318. char_adv00: bone 2 (head) -> 0, bones 3-5 (right arm) -> 1, bones 6-8 (left arm) -> 2, all others 0xFF -- the shift is masked with 0x1F so those land harmlessly on bit 31.
s8[5], difficulty -> starting g_damage_rank: -3, -1, 1, 4, 8. Not clamped on the way in; UpdateDamageRank clamps to [0,15] on its first pass.
Adaptive 0..15 rank. DamageRankModifier indexes g_pBoneDamageByRank[char][bone*0x10 + rank] with it and adds the signed byte to the table damage.
int[2], per player: the bone index this player's shot hit. DispatchHit copies it from (s8)obj+0x190+player before calling ResolveHit.
int[2], per player, written by ResolveHit: 0 = nothing, 1 = damaged and part swapped, 2 = damaged only, 3 = severed, 5 = no effect (the effect table's `2` sentinel). Result 5 scores nothing.
+player*0x98. Added to the 120-point headshot award and then incremented by 10, so consecutive headshots pay 120, 130, 140 ...; any non-head hit zeroes it.
+player*0x98. Hits that scored, for the end-of-stage accuracy grade evt 0x2B reads.
u16[16], bone -> hit-reaction group. Eight groups partitioning the body: 1 head, 2 torso, 3 right arm (bones 3-5), 4 left arm (6-8), 5 pelvis (9), 6 right leg (10-12), 7 left leg (13-15).
15 sound ids for ActorPlayHitVoice: five flesh impacts (BLOOD02/03/04/06, BONE01), then hurt/kill/head voices as (set A, set B) pairs, then two two-entry pools.
Per character type -> per body condition -> a row whose entries at +0x10 are indexed by the last-hit zone (obj+0x1319). Taken only when obj+0x136C & 0x100, which is [open].

Per character type -> per body condition (obj+0x130C) -> u32[8] motion ids indexed by g_bone_reaction_group. Only two distinct rows exist for the humanoids: the ordinary one is head 977, torso 982, r.arm 981, l.arm 979, pelvis 974, r.leg 961, l.leg 960.
f32, stride 0xC, one per ring set. The middle radius; see g_enemy_approach_rings.
f32, stride 0xC, one per ring set. The outer radius; see g_enemy_approach_rings.
Added to g_enemy_approach_steps when the actor starts between the middle and outer rings.
Added on top of g_enemy_approach_steps_mid when the actor starts outside the outer ring, so a distant enemy walks further before it can attack.

u8 per player. An approaching enemy must claim one through TryClaimAttackSlot before it may attack, so only g_max_attackers enemies commit at a time. The holder's index is kept in obj+0x121, and SelectCameraLookAtTarget focuses the camera on whoever holds one.
Set when a claimed attack has actually started; TryClaimAttackSlot short-circuits while it is set.
The camera block's current look-at point (block+0xD8). StepCameraLookAtDamped eases it toward g_camera_lookat_target rather than snapping.
The point the camera *wants* to look at, chosen by SelectCameraLookAtTarget: a single attacking enemy, the midpoint of two, or the cam/ path's own target when no enemies are registered.
The look-at CamEvalPath7 evaluates from the path's target channels, independent of its eye channels -- which is how a path holds the eye still and sweeps the aim.
How many enemies may hold an attack permit at once: 1 or 2.
